about_short_description.short_description: Software to enable B2B Software companies to automate & streamline the customer onboarding and implementation process

product.name: Onboard Customer Onboarding Software
product.description: A platform to automate and manage the customer onboarding and implementation process for B2B software companies, providing customized launch plans and task automation.

product.name: Onboard Collaboration Features
product.description: Tools that enable internal teams and customers to collaborate on onboarding tasks, share updates, and communicate through threaded discussions and integrations.

product.name: Onboard Visibility and Tracking
product.description: A dashboard and reporting tools that provide 360-degree visibility into onboarding progress, task status, and stakeholder accountability.

identifier.value: Onboard Automated Workflows and Task Management

product.name: Onboard Automated Workflows and Task Management
product.description: Automation tools that generate dynamic launch plans, set due dates, assign roles, and trigger workflows based on task completion or delays.

product.name: Onboard Customer Portal
product.description: A customizable portal for customers to view their onboarding launch plan, communicate with the team, and track progress without needing passwords.
